ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Dbmmode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mode selection, 0: DBM off, 1: Normal debug mode, 2: DBM ID output mode, 3: Toggle Mode

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Dbmid
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Unique DBM ID of the DBM instance

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg0
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 0. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane0 = Seg0, if bit[0] = 1, Lane0 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane0 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg1
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 1. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane1= Seg1, if bit[0] = 1, Lane1 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane1 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg2
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 2. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane2= Seg2, if bit[0] = 1, Lane2 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane2 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Muxselseg3
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Mux Select Bits for Lane 3. Split debug bus into 16 bit segments. Seg0 = debug bus [15:0], Seg1 = debug bus[31:16],.... If all bits are 0, Lane3= Seg3, if bit[0] = 1, Lane3 = Seg4, if bit[1] =1, Lane3 = Seg5,...

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Timestamp
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Timestamp value

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TimestampSync
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TimestampSync value

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TsSync
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: TS Sync

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DebugMarker
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Debug Marker

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Rsvd
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Rsvd

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstsyncmode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When the field is set tp 2'b10, sent timestamp. All other values not NA.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstsyncmax
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When trDstSyncMode is set to 2'b10, timestamp will be sent for every 2^(trDstSyncMax + 4) Cluster clocks.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstformat
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: bit[0]: XOR Enable, bit[1]: VLT Enable. Supported values : 2'b3 (XOR+VLT Compression), 2'b1 (XOR Compression), 2'b0 (No Compression)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstvendorframelength
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Specify frame length. Frame Length = trDstVendorFrameLength* 64 ; Frame Length should be a multiple of Bank Data Width.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: Trdstvendorstreamlength
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Specify Stream length. A stream starts with "no compressed packet". Stream length specifies number of frames before a non-compressed packet is sent.Stream Length = 32* 2^(trDstVendorStreamLength + 1)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TraceSourceId
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Trace Source ID (FIXME: Base Address, Tool Issue)

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: TraceFrameFillByte
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Use "Filler Packet" to align a stream of trace packets within a frame boundary.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameLenghtInBytes
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Use trDstImpl[trDstVendorFrameLength] for Frame Length programming. Register field ZBB-ed.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameModeEnable
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Enable Frame Mode (Frame Mode: Always pack "frame length" number of bytes for trace transmission). If flush to memory is stalled (due to silicon bug), we can have incomplete packets in memory. Frame Mode will help SW decoder to avoid reading incomplete transmitted packets. In Frame Mode, SW will get a memory pointer that is aligned to Frame Length. HW will ensure there are no incomplete packets incluced in the region pointed by memory pointer.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: FrameClosureMode
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: Closure Mode: 1: Close frame with a packet no larger than max packet size before any overflow (due to packets crossing frame boundary). 0: Close frame when packets cross boundary. Push back packet crossing frame boundary to packet generator.

ipxact:register.ipxact:description: Configure CLA counter0. One of the 4 counters used for counting cycles after a event match, and trigger a action on match.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ResetOnTarget
ipxact:field.ipxact:description: When Counter = {upper_target,target} reset to 0. With this bit set, counter will provide a periodic tick w/ frequency of (target +1) if the action is set to Auto Incr. The periodic tick will continue till Stop Auto Incr or Clear Counter action.

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: EnableCla

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: ClaChainLoopDelay

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DisableGlobalClockHalt

ipxact:field.ipxact:name: DisableLocalClockHalt
